title: Animated mobile help invitation every 30 seconds
summary: The mobile help icon periodically reveals a Besoin d?aide ? speech bubble.

changes.detail: Added a white speech bubble with soft green border, shadow and pointer. It first appears after 30 seconds and repeats every 30 seconds, visible for about six seconds with a gentle slide/fade.

Uses the existing launcher label and click target; opening chat or hiding the launcher removes the invitation and resets the cycle. Reduced-motion users get a static timed reveal without movement or fades.
